title: Henry B. Plant Museum

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Opening October 3, 2026, a special exhibit at the Henry B. Plant Museum celebrates the 100th anniversary of the historic Tampa Theatre by bringing to life the early years of movie magic in Tampa. Cigar City Cinema: Tampa Goes to the Movies, 1897-1936, will run through February 28, 2026. In 1897, the city’s first theatrical presentation of films took place at the Tampa Bay Casino, a 2,000-seat entertainment venue that Henry Plant constructed on the grounds of the Tampa Bay Hotel. For the next dozen years, the local community watched in awe as the Casino showcased the dramatic evolution of movies from shorts to the first feature-length films to the sprawling epics of D.W. Griffith. Cigar City
